start.title: [TODO:it] A Joyful Feast
start.text:
[TODO:it] Lanterns sway. Laughter rises.
The bride and groom dance.

slip_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Return
slip_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The feast still calls you.
Go back.

shortage.title: [TODO:it] The Last Cup
shortage.text:
[TODO:it] Whispers spread: the wine is gone.
Mary's eyes find her son.

pretend_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Speak
pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The guests will notice.
Do not pretend.

mother.title: [TODO:it] His Mother's Voice
mother.text:
[TODO:it] "They have no more wine," she says.
Then turns to you.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Trust Her Words
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] She has already spoken.
Obey her son.

instruct.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus points to six stone jars.
"Fill them with water."

[TODO:it] Six jars, full of cool water.
"Now draw some out," he says.

taste.text:
[TODO:it] The steward's eyes widen.
"You saved the best for last!"

[TODO:it] The wonder is his alone.
Give thanks.

Give thanks.
